objectives.goal: Verify and recover the top-of-hand IR/distance sensor before using it for approach or grip contact proof.
objectives.policy: IR is not a blocker for visual no-contact learning. IR is a blocker for claiming proximity/contact proof until nonzero known-distance calibration succeeds.
objectives.next_action: Inspect TF Luna/IR wiring, power, UART path, baud rate, and driver frame synchronization; rerun known-distance calibration after nonzero frames are recovered.

objectives.goal: Deploy MIM to learn how to pick up the blocks, starting with the blue block, using slow camera-led no-contact probing before any grip attempt.
objectives.policy: Use slow visible movements. Do not close the claw until visual alignment, collision clearance, and close/lift/verify sequence are explicitly bound.
objectives.next_action: Relax the stale all-camera requirement to accept arm camera plus PC observer, then compute a trusted approach model from the no-contact probes.

success_definition: MIM eventually picks up the blue block only after evidence proves target selection, no-contact alignment, collision-safe approach, gripper alignment, close/lift/verify sequence, and before/after camera confirmation.
